reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the agent that proposed the baselines; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the 26 use-case baseline claims proposed for issue #121, one per use case. Every cited source was re-retrieved and compared with its recorded SHA-256; all match except two dynamic PMC HTML pages (ENIGMA, ClusPro BM5), which were read live. Each rationale was checked against the source text, each method_ids entry against the store and the use case's active comparisons, and the same-data comparison table was rebuilt with the website's rule. All 26 are approved: 2 as proposed, 24 with corrected rationale, value or sources. Ten use cases gained an evidence-gap sentence. Details are in docs/reviews/use-cases/baselines-2026-10-12.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any tool.
A baseline names the reference newer methods are compared with; it is not a recommendation.
Same-data comparisons are counted under current method-type tags; the tag errors listed in the dated review are not fixed here.
uc20260930-source-msalign-v2, added as a source, was not re-retrieved.
